title: ShieldCare Spoilage Allowance: the Share Met for Promptness of the Report
content:
## The share

The share met for promptness of the report on a food spoilage claim under a Northbeam ShieldCare
Protection Plan is read from the days between the day the failure happened and the day it was
reported.

| How promptly the failure was reported | The share met |
| --- | --- |
| reported inside 3 days of it happening | the whole of the ceiling, being 100 percent |
| reported inside 7 days of it happening | 90 percent |
| every other claim | 80 percent |

## Both sides of the two windows

A report made exactly 3 days after the failure is inside 3 days and reaches the whole of the ceiling;
a report made on the 4th day is not, and falls to be tested against the 7 days. A report made exactly
7 days after the failure is inside 7 days and reaches 90 percent; a report made on the 8th day
reaches 80 percent, as does any report later than that.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

Where the figure carried forward from the days out of use is 260.00:

| Days between the failure and the report | Share met | Figure after the share |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 12 | 80 percent | 208.00 |
| 7 | 90 percent | 234.00 |
| 5 | 90 percent | 234.00 |
| 3 | 100 percent | 260.00 |
| 0 | 100 percent | 260.00 |
